Messages.Body:
Praxis: Columbia, SC will be held on February 20, 1999
at Heroes & Dragons in Boozer Center (corner of Bush
and Broad River Roads near I-20 and I-26 in Columbia).

As usual, there is no cost to participate and prizes
will be provided.

Registration is at 10:00 am. Games start at 10:30.

e-mail me (sjoh...@math.sc.edu) if you need more information.
